description: App Fusion legacy guard: denies file writes into legacy/<app> (and the real directories the links point to) and asks before shell commands that would write there. A no-op outside a workspace with analysis/<program>/program.json. Turn it off with the plugin option guard=false (APP_FUSION_GUARD=false in Devin). Matches Claude Code's tool names and Devin's. Under Devin only, a session-start note says how to read the skills there.
